title: Input Symbol Independent of Work Tapes
statement: For a Boolean finite Turing machine $M$, any Boolean input word, state, valid input-head position, original work-tape contents and head positions, three auxiliary work-tape contents and head positions, and output word, the symbol read under the input head in the associated configuration is unchanged when all work tapes and the output are replaced by blank tapes and an empty output, keeping the same input-head position.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a Boolean finite Turing machine
